The question asks WHY Iblis refused. The reason is stated in quran:7:12 and quran:38:76 (he claimed to be better because he was made of fire and Adam of clay), in quran:15:33, in quran:17:61 (the clay objection) and in quran:2:34 (arrogance).

Two expected chunks do not state a reason. In quran-020-116-122 only quran:20:116 mentions the refusal, with no cause. In quran-015-026-032 the refusal is at quran:15:31-32, but the reason only comes in quran:15:33, which is a separate chunk. quran:18:50 gives only 'from the jinn' and 'disobeyed', which is at most partial.
Treating every one of the 8 chunks as an equal 'expected' answer may reward retrieval of chunks that cannot ground a 'why' answer.

The question asks how many years Nuh called (da'a) his people. quran:29:14 says he 'remained among them' a thousand years less fifty. The ayah gives a period of stay, not explicitly a period of calling; reading the stay as the length of the da'wah is an interpretation. A grounded answer should stay with the ayah's wording.
The chunk quran-029-014-018 also mixes in another prophet's story: quran:29:16-18 are about Ibrahim, not Nuh. Only quran:29:14-15 are about Nuh.
suggested_fix: Either reword to 'How long did Nuh stay among his people?' or add a note that answers must use the 'remained among them' framing. Separately, trim the source range to quran:29:14-15 so that the Ibrahim ayat are not tagged prophetId nuh.
